children: South Korea's fiscal deficit could widen again once the current semiconductor-driven surge in tax revenue fades, Fitch Ratings says. The government, in its 2027 budget proposal, expects the national debt to fall to 48.3% of gross domestic product and the fiscal deficit to narrow to 0.1% of GDP next year. Fitch says that the projected fiscal improvement "reflects unusually strong cyclical revenue conditions rather than a permanent strengthening of fiscal capacity" in South Korea. Fitch notes that the government's plan to save part of its 2027 tax-revenue windfall in a Future Response Fund could mitigate the risk that the fiscal improvement proves temporary if earnings growth moderates. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
